Live the Tilal Al Ghaf lifestyle in this bright and modern 3 bedroom + maid’s townhouse in the popular Elan community. This back‑to‑back home offers a peaceful setting, functional layout, and access to world‑class amenities, ideal for families who value comfort, community, and convenience.

The home features an open‑plan living space, a contemporary kitchen, spacious bedrooms, and a private garden perfect for relaxing or entertaining.

With parks, pools, trails, and the stunning lagoon just minutes away, Elan delivers a true resort‑style living experience.
